what: Claude Code 2.1.312 when its API can't be reached (HI-1612): a new empty CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, a made-up API key, `claude -p "say ok"` with a StopFailure hook that saved its input. ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL was a closed port on 127.0.0.1 (refused) or a host under .invalid (notFound). Each retried for about 3 minutes (174 s and 185 s), then its StopFailure hook got this and it exited with 1, printing the message. Nothing reached a real model. Ids and folders replaced.
